$comment: The attributes (<group>:<side>:<suffix>) that stay valid on a side whose own key says it is off: no, none or separate. An entry ending in ':*' allows every suffix below it. Everything else of that side is locked (the Tags sheet's group rows, the inspector's sub fields) and a value left there is an error. The side key's own meta keys (source:parking:left) are always valid. Sources and doubts: docs/research/side-off-attributes.md.
